turns.spoken:
The question of who invented the telephone is complex and involves many people.

Several important figures contributed to the development of the telephone. Bell is often credited with inventing the telephone, but there were other innovators.

For example, Alexander Graham Bell's first intelligible telephone communication was made on March 10, 1876. He later formed the Bell Telephone Company and the United Telephone Company.

The invention of the telephone is a long process with many contributors.
